Address of the Player2 desktop app. Leave empty to probe 127.0.0.1:4315 and :4316; if your desktop app uses another port, enter the full address here.
Player2 web/cloud API root, used when the desktop app is unreachable. Needs a web authorization key. Default: https://api.player2.game
P2 Key obtained through the web authorization window (open it from the Settings button in the customer chat window), or pasted manually. Leave empty to use the desktop app only.
Built-in OpenAI-compatible endpoint preset. Choose Custom to use the endpoint field below instead.
OpenAI-compatible base URL (without /chat/completions). Used only when the provider preset above is Custom.
Bearer key for the fallback endpoint. Leave empty for keyless servers such as Ollama.
Model name sent to the fallback endpoint only. Leave empty to let the server pick.
Overrides the built-in role instruction only. The JSON reply format is appended automatically, so this text never needs to describe it.
Daily request cap is 0: no AI speech is requested. Raise it above 0 to re-enable.
Max AI speech requests per in-game day. 0 turns AI speech off, greying out the two sliders below. Default: 12.
Max characters kept from a single AI line. Ignored while the daily request cap is 0. Default: 400.
Per-request timeout in seconds. Ignored while the daily request cap is 0. Default: 120.
Two ways to connect: the Player2 desktop app (probes local ports) or web authorization (shows a code and link — copy the link into your browser to approve, then a P2 key is stored here).
Web authorization in progress - copy the link and approve in your browser.
Desktop app reachable - local connection active.
Desktop app not detected - local connection inactive.
Use the Settings button in the customer chat window to reopen this panel.

Leave empty to use the built-in instruction.
Lower bound of one bargain step; lower asks are raised to it. Default: 1.
Upper bound of one bargain step; higher asks are capped to it. Default: 90.
Total movement allowed for one customer across all rounds. Default: 60.
